places.name: Yale Art Gallery: A World of Art for Free
places.summary: America's oldest university art museum holds ancient objects, modern paintings, and art from many cultures. Part of it sits inside a famous Louis Kahn building.
places.why_go: The first day starts with a real surprise. Entry is free, so the group can choose a few favorite rooms and leave before anyone feels tired.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and gora: The first day starts with a real surprise. Entry is free, so the group can choose a few favorite rooms and leave before anyone feels tired.

hours.note: Free and open Sunday. The 14:45 target is transfer-sensitive; do not enter after 15:30 and turn the first day into a rush.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Yale University Art Gallery, 1111 Chapel Street, New Haven, Connecticut

places.name: Yale Center for British Art: Light, Art & Kahn
places.summary: Soft daylight fills this calm building of concrete, steel, and wood. It holds the largest British art collection outside the United Kingdom.
places.why_go: The building is as special as the art. It gives Viki strong architecture, Stivka a quiet space, and everyone an easy one-hour visit.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and stivka: The building is as special as the art. It gives Viki strong architecture, Stivka a quiet space, and everyone an easy one-hour visit.

hours.note: Free Sunday. Large bags are not admitted; paid garages sit behind the museum.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Yale Center for British Art, 1080 Chapel Street, New Haven, Connecticut

places.name: Barnes Foundation: Art Walls Like Puzzles
places.summary: Famous paintings share crowded walls with African art, old furniture, and metalwork. The rooms group objects by shape and color instead of date.
places.why_go: Every wall feels like a visual puzzle. The group can search for links between objects instead of reading long museum labels.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and gora: Every wall feels like a visual puzzle. The group can search for links between objects instead of reading long museum labels.

hours.note: Open Monday. Reserve 11:00 timed entry; use Barnes Focus selectively because the galleries intentionally omit standard labels.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Barnes Foundation, 2025 Benjamin Franklin Parkway, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

places.name: Calder Gardens: Moving Art in a Wild Garden
places.summary: Calder's moving sculptures float above quiet rooms and a garden with thousands of plants. Much of the new building hides below the ground.
places.why_go: This is a small but beautiful mix of art, plants, and modern design. It adds fresh air after the busy Barnes galleries.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and sheluvspaco: This is a small but beautiful mix of art, plants, and modern design. It adds fresh air after the busy Barnes galleries.

hours.note: Open Monday. The 11:30 or 13:30 guided walk costs more but adds interpretation to a deliberately sparse space.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Calder Gardens, 2100 Benjamin Franklin Parkway, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

places.name: Baltimore Museum of Industry: The City at Work
places.summary: An old oyster factory now holds print shops, machines, workrooms, and food-making tools. The displays show how ordinary people built Baltimore.
places.why_go: The machines still make the history feel alive. It is a local story that many visitors miss, with strong harbor views outside.
places.best_fit_note: Best for gora: The machines still make the history feel alive. It is a local story that many visitors miss, with strong harbor views outside.

hours.note: Open Tuesday with free on-site parking. Weekday public docent tours are not promised; the galleries still work self-guided.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Baltimore Museum of Industry, 1415 Key Highway, Baltimore, Maryland

places.name: Peabody Library: Five Floors of Iron and Books
places.summary: Five levels of white iron balconies rise toward a huge skylight. About 300,000 old books turn the room into a real library cathedral.
places.why_go: This may be the route's most beautiful indoor view. The visit is free, quiet, and short enough to pair with the industry museum.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and stivka: This may be the route's most beautiful indoor view. The visit is free, quiet, and short enough to pair with the industry museum.

hours.note: The university's published 2026 calendar lists Tuesday October 6 from 10:00-17:00. Public access is free, but private events can still force a late change.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: George Peabody Library, 17 East Mount Vernon Place, Baltimore, Maryland

places.name: Grand Caverns: Strange Shields Under Virginia
places.summary: This cave has welcomed visitors since 1806. Its rare shield-shaped rocks and large rooms look like another world below the Shenandoah Valley.
places.why_go: The cave brings geology and history together without a hard hike. Cool air and dramatic shapes make the long drive feel worth it.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and gora: The cave brings geology and history together without a hard hike. Cool air and dramatic shapes make the long drive feel worth it.

hours.note: April-October daily hours. Tour departures vary; reserve an 11:00-11:30 walking tour and arrive 30 minutes early.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Grand Caverns, 5 Grand Caverns Drive, Grottoes, Virginia

places.name: Frontier Culture Museum: Old Worlds Rebuilt
places.summary: Farms and homes from West Africa and Europe show what early migrants brought to Virginia. Costumed guides explain work, food, faith, and family life.
places.why_go: History becomes easier to understand when the group can walk through real-looking homes and fields. Fall light also makes the open-air museum beautiful.
places.best_fit_note: Best for gora and stivka: History becomes easier to understand when the group can walk through real-looking homes and fields. Fall light also makes the open-air museum beautiful.

hours.note: Planning assumption based on the museum's standard daily season; confirm October 7 hours and interpreter coverage before booking the route variant.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Frontier Culture Museum, 1290 Richmond Avenue, Staunton, Virginia

places.name: Birthplace of Country Music: The Sessions That Changed Sound
places.summary: A small recording studio in Bristol helped launch country music in 1927. Sound booths, films, instruments, and a working radio station tell the story.
places.why_go: The museum is hands-on and easy to enjoy even without loving country music. It shows how simple recording tools changed American sound.
places.best_fit_note: Best for gora and stivka: The museum is hands-on and easy to enjoy even without loving country music. It shows how simple recording tools changed American sound.

hours.note: Open Thursday. The museum recommends 1.5-2 hours for permanent exhibits plus time for the special gallery.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Birthplace of Country Music Museum, 101 Country Music Way, Bristol, Virginia

places.name: Gray Fossil Site: A Five-Million-Year Surprise
places.summary: Road workers found a rich fossil site and moved the highway to save it. Visitors can see fossils, working science labs, and the active dig.
places.why_go: This is real science still happening today. New finds keep changing the story, so it feels more alive than a normal fossil display.
places.best_fit_note: Best for gora and viki: This is real science still happening today. New finds keep changing the story, so it feels more alive than a normal fossil display.

hours.note: Open Thursday. Site tours and visible excavation depend on staffing and weather; the fossil hall and labs remain the guaranteed core.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Gray Fossil Site and Museum, 1212 Suncrest Drive, Gray, Tennessee

places.name: Biltmore: A Giant House and Mountain Gardens
places.summary: America's largest private home has 250 rooms, grand details, gardens, and a glass conservatory. The plan focuses on the best rooms and one garden walk.
places.why_go: The scale is unforgettable and the Blue Ridge setting is beautiful in fall. A focused visit keeps enough energy for Atlanta's metal night.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and gora: The scale is unforgettable and the Blue Ridge setting is beautiful in fall. A focused visit keeps enough energy for Atlanta's metal night.

hours.note: Biltmore is open daily but hours vary. Reserve the earliest practical House entry and leave the estate by 13:00-13:30; do not attempt every included area.

cost.note: Fall House and Grounds starts at $85 and is dynamically priced; $105 is the planning allowance. Reserve at least seven days ahead.

places.address: Biltmore Estate, 1 Lodge Street, Asheville, North Carolina

places.name: Grovewood Village: Looms, Craft & Hidden Cars
places.summary: Old craft buildings hold giant looms, handmade art, and a surprising antique car room. The small campus once made cloth and furniture for Biltmore.
places.why_go: This hidden stop mixes machines, local craft, and calm gardens. It is free and feels much more personal than the huge estate nearby.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and gora: This hidden stop mixes machines, local craft, and calm gardens. It is free and feels much more personal than the huge estate nearby.

hours.note: Gallery and both museums are open Friday in October. Studios are not promised outside the two published 2026 open-studio weekends.

cost.note: Admission and parking are free; a car-museum donation is encouraged.

places.address: Grovewood Village, 111 Grovewood Road, Asheville, North Carolina

places.name: Atlanta Metal Night at Boggs
places.summary: Four heavy bands play a small Atlanta room on the exact Friday night of the trip. The plan uses a real event instead of hoping to find music later.
places.why_go: This is Stivka's main music night and a look at Atlanta's local scene. The group can leave early if the long day starts to feel too heavy.
places.best_fit_note: Best for stivka and gora: This is Stivka's main music night and a look at Atlanta's local scene. The group can leave early if the long day starts to feel too heavy.

hours.note: The date, lineup and venue are published; doors, ticket price and age policy were not yet posted at dataset lock. Recheck the promoter and venue before purchase.

cost.note: Planning allowance only; ticket price was not yet published.

places.address: Boggs Social and Supply, 1310 White Street Southwest, Atlanta, Georgia

places.name: EJI Legacy Museum and National Memorial
places.summary: The museum follows the story from slavery to racial terror, segregation, and mass prison systems. The outdoor memorial honors named victims county by county.
places.why_go: The visit tells difficult history through real voices and clear evidence. It needs time, respect, and a quiet break afterward.
places.best_fit_note: Best for gora and stivka: The visit tells difficult history through real voices and clear evidence. It needs time, respect, and a quiet break afterward.

hours.note: Open Saturday. Reserve a 10:00 Legacy Museum entry, allow 3-4 hours there and 1-1.5 hours at the memorial; free shuttles run every 15 minutes.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Legacy Museum, 400 North Court Street, Montgomery, Alabama

places.name: Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald Museum: Fame and Damage
places.summary: Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald lived and wrote in this Montgomery house. It is the only museum devoted to both of their creative and difficult lives.
places.why_go: The small house makes two famous writers feel human. It gives the day a lighter story before the much deeper EJI visit.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and gora: The small house makes two famous writers feel human. It gives the day a lighter story before the much deeper EJI visit.

hours.note: Open Saturday; arrive by 14:30. Admission is a $5 donation. The upstairs Airbnb suites are not part of ordinary museum access.

cost.note: Requested admission donation.

places.address: Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald Museum, 919 Felder Avenue, Montgomery, Alabama

places.name: Sunday Liturgy at Annunciation Orthodox Church
places.summary: The group joins Orthros and Divine Liturgy at a real Greek Orthodox parish in Mobile. This is worship, not a quick church photo stop.
places.why_go: Sunday faith is protected for all four Orthodox travelers. The group will follow the parish's visitor and Communion rules with respect.
places.best_fit_note: Best for stivka: Sunday faith is protected for all four Orthodox travelers. The group will follow the parish's visitor and Communion rules with respect.

hours.note: Published Sunday schedule is Orthros around 09:00 and Divine Liturgy at 10:00. Call during the week to confirm October 11 and ask about visitor and Communion etiquette.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Annunciation Greek Orthodox Church, 50 South Ann Street, Mobile, Alabama

places.name: Walter Anderson: Wild Gulf Art and the Little Room
places.summary: Walter Anderson turned Gulf animals, myths, and Bible images into bright murals. His hidden Little Room covers every wall with a wild painted world.
places.why_go: The art is colorful, strange, and deeply tied to the coast. It gives the group a gentle stop after church and great time in Ocean Springs.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and stivka: The art is colorful, strange, and deeply tied to the coast. It gives the group a gentle stop after church and great time in Ocean Springs.

hours.note: Sunday hours. Visit 13:15-14:45, then use 30 minutes for Washington Avenue or Front Beach before the New Orleans drive; the Bayou Collection is listed through January 9.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Walter Anderson Museum of Art, 510 Washington Avenue, Ocean Springs, Mississippi

places.name: Biloxi Maritime Museum: Boats, Shrimp and Storms
places.summary: A full-size wooden boat rises inside this waterfront museum. Tools and machines explain shrimping, boatbuilding, and how the Gulf Coast survived major storms.
places.why_go: The stop adds real work and local life to the beautiful coast. Its huge boat and open building also create strong photos.
places.best_fit_note: Best for gora and viki: The stop adds real work and local life to the beautiful coast. Its huge boat and open building also create strong photos.

hours.note: The museum currently publishes Sunday 12:00-16:00 year-round. Arrive at opening after church and confirm October hours one week ahead because older city listings describe a seasonal Sunday schedule.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Maritime and Seafood Industry Museum, 115 1st Street, Biloxi, Mississippi

places.name: Whitney Plantation: History Told by the Enslaved
places.summary: Whitney tells the story of slavery through the names, words, homes, and resistance of enslaved people. It does not turn the plantation house into the hero.
places.why_go: This is honest history, not a romantic old-house tour. The group should listen carefully and leave room to think afterward.
places.best_fit_note: Best for gora and stivka: This is honest history, not a romantic old-house tour. The group should listen carefully and leave room to think afterward.

hours.note: Open Monday and closed Tuesday. Reserve the first 09:30 self-guided audio or guided slot; last entry 15:00.

cost.note: Self-guided audio price; guided adult tour is currently $32.

places.address: Whitney Plantation, 5099 Louisiana Highway 18, Wallace, Louisiana

places.name: Mardi Gras World: Inside the Float Workshop
places.summary: Artists build and paint giant parade floats inside this working warehouse. Visitors see the people and tools behind New Orleans' biggest public celebration.
places.why_go: Huge colors and strange figures bring fun after Whitney's serious morning. The working shop gives the spectacle real craft and human effort.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and gora: Huge colors and strange figures bring fun after Whitney's serious morning. The working shop gives the spectacle real craft and human effort.

hours.note: Open Monday; tours start every half hour and last entry is 16:30. Target 14:00 after returning from Whitney.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Mardi Gras World, 1380 Port of New Orleans Place, New Orleans, Louisiana

places.name: Frenchmen Street Live Music Night
places.summary: The night starts at d.b.a., a trusted music room on Frenchmen Street. One area and one or two strong sets are enough for a great evening.
places.why_go: The group gets real New Orleans music without chasing every bar. It is social, flexible, and easy to end whenever the night stops being fun.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and sheluvspaco: The group gets real New Orleans music without chasing every bar. It is social, flexible, and easy to end whenever the night stops being fun.

hours.note: d.b.a. is open daily. Its current calendar shows a recurring Monday pattern, but the exact October 12 lineup must be checked 7-10 days before travel; no specific band is promised yet.

cost.note: Planning cover-and-one-drink allowance; nightlife remains excluded from the $1,500 target.

places.address: d.b.a. New Orleans, 618 Frenchmen Street, New Orleans, Louisiana

places.name: JAMNOLA: New Orleans Art You Can Step Into
places.summary: Local artists built colorful rooms about music, food, parades, and neighborhood life. Visitors can touch, play, and walk through the art.
places.why_go: This is the route's most playful photo stop. It adds shared fun while still paying local artists to tell the city's story.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and sheluvspaco: This is the route's most playful photo stop. It adds shared fun while still paying local artists to tell the city's story.

hours.note: Open Monday and closed Tuesday/most Wednesdays. Pre-booking is required; target 14:00-15:30.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: JAMNOLA, 940 Frenchmen Street, New Orleans, Louisiana

places.name: St. Louis Cemetery No. 1: Tombs, Stories and Respect
places.summary: New Orleans' oldest cemetery holds raised tombs and the stories of Marie Laveau, Homer Plessy, and many local families. Entry requires an approved guide.
places.why_go: The tour connects striking buildings with real people, faith, law, and folklore. The group will treat it as a sacred place, not a ghost attraction.
places.best_fit_note: Best for stivka and gora: The tour connects striking buildings with real people, faith, law, and folklore. The group will treat it as a sacred place, not a ghost attraction.

hours.note: Official small-group tours leave every 15 minutes through 15:45. Reserve 09:00, check in 15 minutes early at 501 Basin Street, and follow active-cemetery etiquette.

cost.note: Authorized daytime tour currently starts at $29.

places.address: St. Louis Cemetery Number 1, 425 Basin Street, New Orleans, Louisiana

places.name: Lake Martin: A Quiet Boat Through Cypress Trees
places.summary: A small boat moves slowly through cypress water, birds, and alligator habitat. The guide explains the living wetland and Cajun work around it.
places.why_go: The quiet boat feels close to nature instead of like a loud theme ride. Four travelers fit the small-skiff experience perfectly.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and gora: The quiet boat feels close to nature instead of like a loud theme ride. Four travelers fit the small-skiff experience perfectly.

hours.note: Tours usually run daily but times vary with demand, weather and season. Request a 13:00-13:30 departure and obtain final written confirmation and directions.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Cajun Country Swamp Tours, 1209 Rookery Road, Breaux Bridge, Louisiana

places.name: Avery Island: TABASCO, Gardens and a Buddha
places.summary: See how TABASCO pepper mash ages in barrels, then drive through a lush garden on a salt dome. A quiet Buddha shrine waits among the plants.
places.why_go: One stop brings food, machines, geology, wildlife, and a peaceful garden together. It is strange, colorful, and easy for everyone to enjoy.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and gora: One stop brings food, machines, geology, wildlife, and a peaceful garden together. It is strange, colorful, and easy for everyone to enjoy.

hours.note: Open Tuesday. The bundled factory and garden experience is self-paced; begin by 10:30 and confirm the factory's final tour time, which can differ from garden closing.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: TABASCO Factory and Jungle Gardens, 329 Avery Island Road, Avery Island, Louisiana

places.name: Space Center Houston: Real Moonshot Hardware
places.summary: See flown spacecraft, a huge Saturn V rocket, and the working Johnson Space Center campus. A tram or Mission Control visit makes the experience feel real.
places.why_go: The size of the machines creates a powerful final-day reveal. It mixes engineering, human courage, and the true story of space work.
places.best_fit_note: Best for gora and sheluvspaco: The size of the machines creates a powerful final-day reveal. It mixes engineering, human courage, and the true story of space work.

hours.note: Current operating hours are 10:00-18:00; reserve 10:15 timed entry and a tram option. NASA is a working facility and tours can close without notice.

cost.note: Planning maximum combines current $39.95 online general-admission ceiling and $15 Historic Mission Control add-on; standard options may cost less.

places.address: Space Center Houston, 1601 East NASA Parkway, Houston, Texas

places.name: Rothko Chapel: Dark Paintings and Shared Silence
places.summary: Fourteen dark Rothko paintings surround a quiet eight-sided chapel. Outside, a broken black column seems to float above water.
places.why_go: The group gets a calm spiritual ending after eleven busy days. There is nothing to rush, photograph, or solve inside.
places.best_fit_note: Best for stivka and viki: The group gets a calm spiritual ending after eleven busy days. There is nothing to rush, photograph, or solve inside.

hours.note: Open Wednesday but closes for private programs about twice monthly; check one week ahead. Silence is expected and interior photography is prohibited.

cost.note: Adult planning price; reconfirm before travel.

places.address: Rothko Chapel, 3900 Yupon Street, Houston, Texas

places.name: Buffalo Bayou Cistern: Light Under 220 Columns
places.summary: A huge 1926 water tank now holds art beneath Houston. Light, sound, and reflections move through more than 220 concrete columns.
places.why_go: The underground room feels endless and unreal. It turns old city engineering into one of the route's strongest hidden-gem moments.
places.best_fit_note: Best for viki and gora: The underground room feels endless and unreal. It turns old city engineering into one of the route's strongest hidden-gem moments.

hours.note: Open Wednesday; tour slots run through the afternoon. Reserve a 14:30-15:30 entry and confirm the Undercurrents schedule, listed through January 24, 2027.

cost.note: Planning allowance; select the current Undercurrents or history-tour ticket when October inventory opens.

places.address: Buffalo Bayou Park Cistern, 105 Sabine Street, Houston, Texas
